FN-DFE9THN-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 322
Committee: County & Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Clyde Chambliss
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/16/2024
Senate Bill 322 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Department of Corrections
(DOC), by a department estimated $1.5 million dollars, to: (1) appoint administrators as
necessary to oversee operations and management of DOC facilities; and (2) appoint up to an
additional 15 employees to establish constituent services for DOC.
In addition, this bill would increase the administrative obligations of the Joint Legislative Prison
Oversight Committee, by an undetermined amount, to study and address services provided by
DOC to constituents and families of inmates.

FN-DFE9THN-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 322
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Senator Clyde Chambliss
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/29/2024
Senate Bill 322 as passed the Senate would increase the obligations of the Department of
Corrections (DOC) by a department estimated $1.5 million dollars annually beginning in Fiscal
Year 2024 through Fiscal Year 2028, to: (1) employ 14 administrators to oversee operations and
management of DOC facilities; and (2) employ15 exempt employees to establish constituent
services for DOC. This bill provides that these positions would be exempt from the State Merit
System and that the DOC commissioner would appoint these personnel and set their
compensation, not to exceed that of the commissioner.
This bill would also further increase the obligations of DOC by an undetermined amount
dependent on the compensation established by the commissioner for the two additional deputy
commissioners that may be appointed, and whose salary would be set, by the commissioner, as
provided by this bill.
In addition, this bill would increase the administrative obligations of the Joint Legislative Prison
Oversight Committee to provide for the membership, duties, and responsibilities of the Family
of the Incarcerated Advisory Board and to study and address services provided by DOC to
constituents and families of inmates.
Further this bill would increase the obligations of the Department of Examiners of Public
Accounts, by an undetermined amount, to hire an additional staff member to assist in the
operations of the Joint Prison Oversight Committee and provide oversight to the Board.
